shots.title: Replace slow daily-cadence git fixture setup with a deterministic fast history builder (#516)
shots.notes: Raised #516 from the S144 release-gate timeout and replaced the daily-cadence fixture's 65 index-based `git commit` calls with a faster `commit-tree`/`update-ref` history builder.

shots.title: Rerun focused analyzer and release-gate full-suite validation (#516)
shots.notes: Focused analyzer, paired analyzer+MCP stress, typecheck, and full-suite release validation all passed after the fixture hardening.

conditions.description: The issue was discovered during S144 release validation rather than during S143.97 planning, so S144 was temporarily paused while #516 was raised and fixed.

training.description: Git analyzer fixtures that synthesize many commits can become full-suite release hazards on Windows even when focused reruns pass.
training.outcome: The daily-cadence regression now preserves the 65-commit signal while avoiding 65 slow worktree/index commits.

nutrition.description: `corepack pnpm vitest run tests/core/analyzers/git.test.ts` passed: 24 tests.
`corepack pnpm vitest run tests/core/analyzers/git.test.ts tests/mcp/index-src.test.ts` passed: 85 tests.
`corepack pnpm test` passed: 231 test files passed, 1 skipped; 3629 tests passed, 25 skipped.
`slope map --check` reported current and `slope roadmap validate` passed with only historical warnings.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: A useful interruption. The release gate was telling us the test fixture itself needed hardening, not just another rerun.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: When a synthetic git-history test needs many commits, build the graph cheaply with git plumbing instead of repeatedly committing through the worktree and index.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The focused test passed but still sat close enough to the timeout budget that full-suite contention could tip it over.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: S144 can now resume with a cleaner full-suite gate instead of carrying a known release flake.

bunker_locations: Full-suite pressure can expose timing hazards in tests that are merely slow in focused mode.
Repeated `git commit` fixture setup is expensive on Windows and should be avoided for large synthetic histories.
yardage_book_updates: `tests/core/analyzers/git.test.ts` now uses `git commit-tree` plus `git update-ref` to build the 65-commit daily-cadence fixture.
Issue #516 is triaged into S143.97 and should close when this PR merges.
course_management_notes: Issue #516 should close when the PR containing S143.97 merges.
Return to S144 release validation after S143.97 closeout.
